get.description:
Keycloak sends the browser here. Creates a new session and sets the session cookie.

Failures are RFC 9457 problems for API clients. A browser navigation (Accept: text/html) is
sent back to its app with `?auth_error=<code>` instead, which the app shows as a translated
message (CLAUDE.md rule d: no raw codes or JSON on screen).

Redirect the browser to Keycloak (authorization code + PKCE, state, nonce).

`returnTo` must be a same-origin relative path; anything else lands on `/`.

post.description: End this session and the Keycloak session; clears the cookie.

get.description: The logged-in user, active tenant, switchable tenants, CSRF token and permissions.

post.description: Make another of the user's tenants active. Issues a new session ID and CSRF token.

get.description:

Checks no dependency, so a database outage never makes the orchestrator restart healthy API
pods.

get.description:
Return 200 when PostgreSQL, Valkey, NATS and Keycloak all answer within the timeout.

Otherwise 503, naming the failing dependency with a reason code. The outbox relay and the
consumer worker are reported from their heartbeats (`outbox_relay`, `event_consumers`) but
are informational: when they are down the response lists them under `degraded`, still 200.
System roles first, then custom roles by name, with how many users hold each.
